headline: Unbeaten UAH and Trevecca cancel each other out
dek: UAH and Trevecca, the only programmes yet to lose a match this season, drew with each other on Wednesday. UAH have now won four and drawn one, and have conceded three goals in those five matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The tallest bar is not the strongest side: West Alabama have scored fourteen and conceded fourteen, and have won once in seven matches.

wire.line: Spring Hill have scored once in four matches, conceded ten, and are still without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded four goals for Trevecca and kept three clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Alabama's fourteen goals have come from seven different scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: David Nunez has five goals from twenty-two shots for West Alabama.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Patrick Schott has made thirty-three saves for Union, more than any other goalkeeper listed, and has conceded ten goals.

last_match.line: Both sides remain unbeaten; UAH had already won at West Alabama, and Trevecca had drawn at Montevallo.

next_match.line: AUM have yet to concede in conference play; Christian Brothers have yet to lose in it.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
